message: I remember the time we had a surprise blackout during a storm, and I smugly pulled out my trusty lantern while my neighbors fumbled around in the dark. It felt good to be prepared! We ended up sharing snacks and stories by the warm glow of my lantern, and I couldn’t help but think, 'I told you so!' 😊 It’s a gentle reminder that a little preparation goes a long way. How do you stay cozy and connected during power outages?
